results: Two isolated browser sessions sign in through the real login form
Live collaboration, viewed-scene presence, and concurrent field edits converge in both sessions
Duplicate uploads share one asset and protected thumbnails update live
Graceful backend restart preserves state and an unconfirmed edit retries successfully
Abrupt backend termination recovers committed operations without duplicating a lost-acknowledgment write
Agent drafts stay unapplied until approval; rejection, stale checks, and failure tokens leave the board intact
Restore to seq 40 rejects a stale preview, then commits a new operation that converges in both sessions
A mid-session role downgrade blocks writes through the UI with the existing JWT
Final board, operation ordering, persisted bytes, and mobile rendering are consistent
